decisions.evidence: Complete six-step proof and all 21 declared supplier statements checked. Codimension m-k+1>=2 makes the complement connected; a complete metric on the complement supplies an injective minimizing arc. The projection-commutator ODE transports its normal spaces; finite rotations connect (k-1)-frames because k-1<m-1. The compact arc tube is constructed by Euclidean retraction and local inverses, avoiding an invalid boundaryless tube invocation. Graph correction puts end disks in the spheres; free transverse/end-disk signs align the prescribed residual GL(m-k) components. k=1 gives an arc and empty tangent frame. AC_omega is explicit for proper embedding, tube and completeness. Wall p.148 supplies the band route; no new defect found.

Compact closed sphere data ensure finiteness and no choice is used. Cancellation is not asserted by this definition.

Complete three-step proof, all nine supplier statements and the current cancellation, local-model and attaching-isotopy arguments checked. Local stable/unstable spheres are the framed belt/attaching spheres transported by regular flow; unique transverse crossing corresponds bijectively to an unparametrized q-to-p orbit. Local Morse handles followed by geometric cancellation give a product SLAB relative to L_a, not an upper sublevel product and not removal of critical points from unchanged f. The unit count fails to display the single-point condition but the pair is isotopic to a cancelling one: reversing this finger needs no general Whitney theorem. The revised qualification preserves exactly this distinction and AC_omega. No new defect found.

Read all seven steps, the cubic caveat, all nine supplier statements, and the COMPLETE Milnor First Cancellation Theorem argument (PDF pp.53–71, printed pp.48–66: Hypothesis 5.5, Assertions 1–6, Theorem 5.6, Lemmas 5.7/5.9). Field support is compact in arbitrary U; equality of f off U and equality of normalized speeds are explicitly not claimed. Cubic endpoint inequality verifies why stronger function support is false. AC_omega explicit. No new defect found.

Complete remark and all eight suppliers checked. A slide preserves each handle count; cancellation removes one handle in each adjacent index. Finite relative CW and relative rational cellular homology compute Euler characteristic; rank-nullity cancels consecutive boundary ranks in the alternating sum. Removing one handle changes chi by +/-1, so count balance is necessary but insufficient. The remark does not identify matrix basis operations with deleting a unit, and uses no unstated Euler theorem. Lück pp.6–7 checked. No new defect found.
